row.notes: Small getter. ctx+0x18 = config node. First asks unnamed thunk 0x143a450f0 (.data1 body, presumably has-setting) whether Story.forcedTitleUpdateValue exists in the node; if yes reads it with Ne_Get_SettingBool 0x143a43b90 (default 0) into a stack byte; if not, falls back to bit 1 of the first byte returned by Ne_Get_FeatureFlags 0x1413ca0d0. Returns that bit as bool. Only code caller: 0x141d9c07b in 0x141d9b5f0 (passes [rsi+0x2d8]), inside a djb2 switch case 0x326098eb, result gates a branch. The second riprel hit 0x140a7127c is a false positive (not an instruction operand). Existing name kept. hidden-modes 2026-11-13 (vmknolle-hidden-a): read from the Ghidra decompile.
